Spectra Sense

Experimental

Mesh, Doppler, ranging, and a track

These estimators are exercised on a synthetic shadow field. The crosshair is the generator script. The violet disc is filter spread. Nothing on this page is a meter accuracy, and a track is not a person.

EXPERIMENTAL · SIMULATION. Accuracy stays unclaimed until a hardware recording is scored with the evaluation script. Radar mode is unchanged: it still draws coarse activity, not this mesh.

Capability matrix

literature tier · this repo

The tier is what a calibrated deployment of this class of radio might attempt. The status is what this repository does. A ship row is capture and a movement-like detector, not a person and not a published lab score.

TierCapabilityHereNote
shipRSSI and CSI captureimplementedThe ESP32-S3 and ESP32-C5 images build and have not been flashed. The C6 image has not been built.
shipMovement-like activityimplementedAmplitude left a frozen baseline. Not a person, and not occupancy.
shipAmplitude spectrumimplementedA spectrum of amplitude. Not a velocity.
betaRoom empty or occupiednot_implementedNeeds a per-home empty-room baseline. The occupancy module stays disabled.
experimentalStill presenceexperimentalStill presence is reported only from an optional LD2410 still-target bit, or an LD2450 target whose speed field is 0. Wi-Fi does not report a still person. Those are the module's fields, not a person. No hardware benchmark file is in this checkout, so the console shows no score.
betaStill-subject rhythm (not measured)researchNot a breathing measurement. A band-limited amplitude peak can be computed in research code and is not shown as a rate. A single link still has a blind spot.
betaCoarse activity classnot_implementedNo classifier is trained. Published lab scores are not this product's accuracy.
betaZone from three or more nodesexperimentalThe ellipse mesh runs on a generator. Meter error waits on a hardware file.
researchGesturenot_implementedFragile across rooms. Not shipped.
researchHeart ratenot_implementedNot estimated.
researchCounting more than two peoplenot_implementedNo count is produced.
researchAngle or time of flightnot_implementedNeeds a phase-locked array such as ESPARGOS. One antenna cannot supply it.

Hardware to buy before trusting any of this

  • Preferred nodes are an ESP32-C6 (2.4 GHz Wi-Fi 6) or an ESP32-C5 (2.4 and 5 GHz), each with an external IPEX antenna. Eight to start, two on each side of a 4 m square. Sixteen is the denser follow-up. Keep every pair of radios more than 1 m apart.
  • The ESP32-S3 and ESP32-C5 images in this repo build and have not been flashed. The C6 image has not been built. C5 CSI is an 8-bit L-LTF request and stays unmapped, so do not reuse the S3 index map on that chip.
  • One dedicated transmitter sends ESP-NOW broadcasts at 6 Mbps OFDM, not 1 Mbps 11b. The task interval is 50 ms. That interval was not measured on a radio.
  • A USB cable per board, a powered hub, floor tape, and a tape measure. Record the antenna part and do not mix unmarked antennas in one session.
  • Two of the same boards, kept for a separate FTM session. Angle and calibrated phase wait on an optional phase-locked array such as ESPARGOS. That array is not required for the first mesh, and it is not an identity sensor.

Placement, the recording order, and the JSON the evaluation script accepts are in docs/research/experiment-plan.md. The script refuses simulation. Published lab scores are not this product's accuracy.
